arguments.description: Verify ledger append and final hashes
arguments.command:
Get-Content D:\lean\AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Tail 6
Write-Output '--- final hash ---'
Get-FileHash D:\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\S1894D5LargeImageActual.lean -Algorithm SHA256 | Select-Object Hash
Get-FileHash D:\lean\.lake\build\lib\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\S1894D5LargeImageActual.olean -Algorithm SHA256 | Select-Object Hash
Select-String -Path D:\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\S1894D5LargeImageActual.lean -Pattern 'sorry|axiom |admit' | Select-Object -First 5
